Metadata.Title: RDS PostgreSQL 5432 least-privilege Security Group policy
Metadata.LastReviewNote: 04/11/2026: dong bo voi runbook P2-Q01 da chot (TLS da kiem chung, P2-NH01 pass 100%, cua so public da dong luc 10:14, bai hoc ISP loc port 5432) + them 3 khoi VerifiedRuntimeState / DriftControl / VerificationPlaybook va 4 guard moi trong lint (18 test cases).
Metadata.ThreatModel: Bot quet Internet lien tuc do port 5432 tren IPv4 cong khai. Neu mo 0.0.0.0/0, RDS bi brute-force trong vai phut. Policy nay chi cho phep dung IP /32 co dinh cua nhom dev va Security Group cua Backend; moi nguon khac bi DROP tai lop SG (client thay 'Connection timed out').

TargetSecurityGroup.Vpc: Default VPC of ap-southeast-1 (created by infra/aws/terraform_rds.tf - P2-Q01)
TargetSecurityGroup.ManagedBy: Terraform (P2-Q01) owns the SG shell; P2-Q02 owns the ingress rules only
TargetSecurityGroup.StatefulNote: Security Group la stateful: goi tin phan hoi cua ket noi inbound duoc phep tu dong, nen egress deny-all KHONG lam hong ket noi psql.

VerifiedRuntimeState.EvidenceSource: infra/aws/rds_setup.md (P2-Q01, ban chot 04/11/2026 - muc 3.1..3.5 va 10.1) + describe read-only ngay 04/11/2026
VerifiedRuntimeState.TlsEvidence: rds.force_ssl=1 (parameter group fpl-fantasy-db-postgres15) + CA rds-ca-rsa2048-g1; psql sslmode=require + conninfo OK (rds_setup muc 3.1); client khong TLS bi tu choi 'no encryption' (muc 3.2).
VerifiedRuntimeState.BackendIntegrationEvidence: P2-NH01 (Nhat) PASS 100% tren RDS that trong cua so public 08:51-10:14 ngay 04/11/2026 (rds_setup muc 3.3) -> bang chung allow-path doc lap thu 2, khong phu thuoc psql tren may Quang.
VerifiedRuntimeState.DevCidrRecheck: curl -s https://checkip.amazonaws.com ngay 04/11/2026 = 14.191.166.167 -> khop rule R1. Bang chung TLS 04/11 (rds_setup muc 3.2) ghi client host '123.31.x.x' la phien tu mang khac (hotspot), KHONG phai IP nha. Truoc moi phien psql truc tiep: chay lai checkip; neu khac thi lam moi theo muc 6.2 (sua JSON -> lint -> 6.4 -> revoke IP cu o muc 11.1).
VerifiedRuntimeState.PublicWindow: Mo 08:39 -> dong 10:14 ngay 04/11/2026 (~95 phut, dai hon moc 30 phut); sau do PubliclyAccessible=false va TCP 5432 tu Internet -> timeout (rds_setup muc 3.4).

DriftControl.Issue: Rule R1 dang ton tai tren AWS nhung terraform_rds.tf va state deu ghi ingress = [] (rds_setup muc 10.1) -> cau hinh that va cau hinh trong IaC dang lech nhau.
DriftControl.MeasuredBehavior: 02/11/2026: sau khi them rule bang CLI, 'terraform plan -detailed-exitcode' tra 0 -> Terraform KHONG xoa rule them ngoai (do thuc te, khong suy doan).
RealRisks: terraform destroy + apply lai -> SG rong ingress, DB fail-closed cho toi khi chay lai muc 6.4
May khac clone repo roi apply -> khong co rule nao (dung thiet ke P2-Q01, nhung phai biet)
Ai do them khoi ingress inline voi dev_cidr_blocks = [] -> TF quan ly tap rule (authoritative) va revoke het
DriftControl.CodifyOwner: Quang - PR Level 4 rieng. Theo chi dao 04/11/2026, P2-Q02 chi dong 2 file (security_groups.md + rds_sg_policy.json) nen KHONG sua terraform_rds.tf trong task nay; HCL mau nam o muc 6.7 cua security_groups.md.
CutoverSteps: 1. Review + merge PR them khoi ingress (dynamic theo var.dev_cidr_blocks) vao terraform_rds.tf

2. Revoke rule CLI: aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0f5970a2c3b47878a --region ap-southeast-1 --protocol tcp --port 5432 --cidr 14.191.166.167/32 (DB dang private nen khong anh huong ai)
3. terraform apply -var='dev_cidr_blocks=["14.191.166.167/32"]' -> TF tao lai dung rule do no quan ly
4. Verify: describe-security-groups tra dung 1 rule /32 va terraform plan -detailed-exitcode = 0
DriftControl.DestructiveApplyGuard: Sau cutover, TUYET DOI khong apply khi dev_cidr_blocks = [] (se revoke het va quay ve deny-all). Bat buoc truyen -var/-var-file khi apply va bat buoc co dong 'Plan: 0 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy' duoc review truoc khi apply.

VerificationPlaybook.Requirement: Tu IP la (ngoai whitelist): port 5432 phai 'Connection timed out' / 'filtered' (AC-5).
VerificationPlaybook.MethodologyCaveat: Timeout MOT MINH khong du ket luan SG da chan, vi co 2 nguyen nhan khac cung cho ra timeout: (a) DB private (publicly_accessible=false) -> khong co route tu Internet (lop L1); (b) ISP cua nhom dev da tung loc port 5432 (rds_setup muc 3.4 va muc 9) -> quet 5432 tu mang do luon timeout du SG mo hay dong.
VerificationPlaybook.BaselineControlTest: Bat buoc chay 2 phep doi chung truoc khi ket luan: (1) tu cung may/lenh do, kiem tra 1 dich khac chac chan mo port 5432 tren Internet (vd portquiz.net:5432) -> neu cung timeout thi ISP dang loc, khong phai SG; (2) mo cua so public tam (rds_setup muc 3.5) de loai nguyen nhan L1 -> luc do timeout moi quy duoc cho lop L2 (SG).
VerificationPlaybook.IspPort5432FilterLesson: 04/11/2026: RDS public IP 52.221.3.116 bi loc port 5432 tren duong mang cua nhom (portquiz.net:5432 van OK => khong phai firewall cuc bo); tat/bat public access de xin IP moi 54.151.153.247 thi ket noi duoc ngay.
ExternalNetworkOptions: VPS/cloud khac (khong thuoc VPC nay) - co IP cong khai co dinh, de chup anh nhat
GitHub Actions runner - co the tu dong hoa kiem tra dinh ky
ControlCommands: timeout 15 bash -c 'cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/portquiz.net/5432'; echo EXIT=$?   # EXIT=0 => ISP khong chan 5432, timeout toi RDS la do SG/L1

aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0f5970a2c3b47878a --region ap-southeast-1 --query 'SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions[?IpRanges[?CidrIp==`0.0.0.0/0`] || Ipv6Ranges[?CidrIpv6==`::/0`]]' --output json
VerificationPlaybook.CurrentEvidence: 02/11/2026: allow-path tu IP dev OK (SSLRequest -> 'S'), port 5433 timeout (V5), cua so public 236s (V6). 04/11/2026: TLS + P2-NH01 PASS tren RDS that; sau khi dong cua so (10:14) TCP 5432 tu Internet -> timeout (rds_setup muc 3.4) - nhung do la timeout khi DB private nen CHI chung minh L1. AC-5 van can 1 phep quet tu mang khac CO BASELINE (muc 9.0 cua security_groups.md).

AuthorizeIngress.CliTarget: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id <SG_ID> --ip-permissions <mang IpPermissions duoi day>
AuthorizeIngress.ShapeNotice: Moi phan tu PHAI dung shape AWS IpPermission: CIDR nam trong IpRanges[].CidrIp, mo ta nam trong IpRanges[].Description. Dat 'CidrIp'/'Description' o cap ngoai se bi CLI tu choi (Unknown parameter).
AuthorizeIngress.LeastPrivilegeRationale: Moi nguon la mot /32 duy nhat (khong dung CIDR rong), chi 1 port duy nhat 5432, chi giao thuc tcp. Mot rule = mot nguoi/mot SG -> revoke chinh xac khi offboarding.

IpRanges.Description: P2-Q02 dev-01 Quang fixed IP (verified 2026-11-02 via checkip.amazonaws.com)

AuthorizeIngress.AppliedStatePolicy: Rule dang ky la IP that cua may dev, da ap dung len SG ngay 2026-11-02 (xem security_groups.md muc 8.4) va van dung khi kiem tra lai ngay 2026-11-04 (checkip = 14.191.166.167, describe-security-groups tra dung 1 rule /32). Them IP moi = them 1 phan tu vao mang nay (moi IP 1 rule /32, tran MaxIngressRules = 5) roi chay lint + muc 6.4. Khong bao gio dung 203.0.113.x (dai tai lieu RFC 5737, khong dinh tuyen duoc) trong rule that.
AuthorizeIngress.RuntimeConsistencyGuard: Lint TC-14 doi chieu CIDR active trong file nay voi VerifiedRuntimeState.DevCidrs -> doi IP o mot noi ma quen noi kia se FAIL ngay (chan tai lieu va cau hinh lech nhau).

AuthorizeEgress.CliTarget: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id <SG_ID> --ip-permissions <mang IpPermissions duoi day>
AuthorizeEgress.Rationale: RDS khong bao gio chu dong mo ket noi ra ngoai. Egress deny-all (shell trong terraform_rds.tf dung 127.0.0.1/32) chan luon duong data-exfiltration. Mang rong o day nghia la 'khong them rule egress nao'.

ComplianceGuards.ForbiddenSourceSecurityGroupIdsWhy: launch-wizard-1 - SG mo SSH tu 0.0.0.0/0, khong bao gio duoc lam nguon cho RDS.

ForbiddenRuleExamples_DO_NOT_APPLY.Why: Mo PostgreSQL cho toan bo Internet - vi pham truc tiep Acceptance Criteria, la nguyen nhan so 1 khien RDS bi ma hoa to cong khai.
Mo ca dai IPv6 Internet, tuong duong 0.0.0.0/0 nhung de bi bo sot khi audit.
Mo 'all traffic' thay vi chi 5432 - bien DB thanh be mat tan cong toan bo port (co Description day du nen chi vi pham protocol/port).
Nguon qua rong (ca dai /16 cua ISP) - bat ky khach hang nao cua ISP do cung vao duoc DB.
Dung SG mo cua (launch-wizard-1) lam nguon - vi pham least privilege qua 2 lop.
